day-ruler-deputies.title: Day Ruler Deputies
day-ruler-deputies.summary: Move through the Chaldean order to reveal the next two deputies of each ruler.

zodiac-longitude.title: Zodiac Longitude
zodiac-longitude.summary: Turn sign and degree into one 0–360° number.

part-of-fortune.title: Part of Fortune
part-of-fortune.summary: Use sect to choose the luminary order, then normalize the result around the circle.

annual-profections.title: Annual Profections
annual-profections.summary: Advance one whole sign per year and wrap after twelve.

nutation.title: Nutation
nutation.summary: Model the faster wobble riding on top of a slower precessional motion.
nutation.code: precession = slow_rotation(t)\nnutation = amplitude * sin(frequency * t)\ntrue_axis = apply_nutation(precession, nutation)

major-aspects.title: Major Aspects
major-aspects.summary: Cycle through the major aspect families and watch the zodiac geometry redraw from any starting sign.
major-aspects.code:
signs = ["Aries","Taurus","Gemini","Cancer","Leo","Virgo",
         "Libra","Scorpio","Sagittarius","Capricorn","Aquarius","Pisces"]

offsets = {"Sextile": 2, "Square": 3, "Trine": 4, "Opposition": 6}

i = signs.index(sign)
step = offsets[aspect]
print(signs[(i + step) % 12], signs[(i - step) % 12])
major-aspects.note: Conjunction is the zero-step special case: both points occupy the same zodiac position.

dodecatemoria.title: Dodecatemoria / Twelfth-Parts
dodecatemoria.summary: Multiply the degree within the sign by twelve, project that distance from the start of the sign, and wrap around the zodiac.
dodecatemoria.code:
signs = ["Aries","Taurus","Gemini","Cancer","Leo","Virgo",
         "Libra","Scorpio","Sagittarius","Capricorn","Aquarius","Pisces"]

sign_start = signs.index(sign) * 30
twelfth_part = (sign_start + degree * 12) % 360
print(twelfth_part)

monomoiria.title: Monomoiria
monomoiria.summary: Assign a planetary ruler to each individual degree by cycling through a seven-planet sequence.

egyptian-bounds.title: Bounds / Terms
egyptian-bounds.summary: Find which unequal planetary bound contains a given degree. Unlike decans, the intervals are not equal.

decans-faces.title: Decans / Faces
decans-faces.summary: Divide each sign into three equal 10° sections, then assign the face ruler from the traditional sequence.

planetary-joys.title: Planetary Joys
planetary-joys.summary: Represent the traditional planetary joys as a direct house-to-planet mapping.

whole-sign-house-distance.title: Whole-Sign House Distance
whole-sign-house-distance.summary: Count signs from one reference sign to another and convert the distance into a whole-sign house number.

day-night-lots.title: Day / Night Reversal of Lots
day-night-lots.summary: Flip the subtraction order of the significators when the Lot formula is sect-dependent.

lot-houses.title: Lot Houses
lot-houses.summary: Once a Lot is calculated, use its sign as a reference and count whole-sign houses from it.
lot-houses.code:
lot_sign = int(lot_longitude // 30)
planet_sign = int(planet_longitude // 30)
house = (planet_sign - lot_sign) % 12 + 1
print(house)

derived-lots.title: Lots Derived from Lots
derived-lots.summary: Feed a calculated Lot into another Lot formula, making one derived point an input to the next.
derived-lots.code:
fortune = lot(asc, moon, sun)
derived = lot(asc, fortune, planet)
print(derived)

monthly-profections.title: Monthly Profections
monthly-profections.summary: Subdivide the annual profection into a faster sign cycle nested inside the annual time-lord year.

annual-time-lord.title: Annual Time Lord
annual-time-lord.summary: Find the profected Ascendant sign for the year, then look up that sign's traditional ruler.
annual-time-lord.code:
profected = signs[(signs.index(rising) + age) % 12]
time_lord = rulers[profected]
print(profected, time_lord)

planetary-years.title: Planetary Years
planetary-years.summary: Store minor, mean, and greater planetary periods and retrieve the appropriate measure for a timing procedure.

planetary-period-calendar.title: Days / Months from Planetary Periods
planetary-period-calendar.summary: Convert a traditional planetary period into a calendar length while keeping the source convention explicit.
planetary-period-calendar.code:
days = period_years * days_per_year
months = period_years * months_per_year

solar-phases.title: Solar Phases
solar-phases.summary: Measure a planet's longitude relative to the Sun and classify its phase from separation and orientation.

under-beams-combustion-cazimi.title: Under the Beams / Combustion / Cazimi
under-beams-combustion-cazimi.summary: Classify solar proximity by increasingly tight angular-distance thresholds.

morning-evening-star.title: Morning vs. Evening Star
morning-evening-star.summary: Compare a planet's position with the Sun to determine whether it is on the morning or evening side, then refine with actual visibility conditions.

oriental-occidental.title: Oriental / Occidental
oriental-occidental.summary: Apply the traditional oriental/occidental rule appropriate to the planet rather than using one rule for every body.

lunar-application.title: Lunar Application
lunar-application.summary: Search forward for the next aspect the Moon perfects with another planet.

lunar-separation.title: Lunar Separation
lunar-separation.summary: Search backward for the aspect from which the Moon most recently separated.

void-of-course.title: Void of Course
void-of-course.summary: Search the Moon's remaining travel in its current sign for a future perfection, stopping at the sign boundary.

translation-light.title: Translation of Light
translation-light.summary: Detect a body separating from one planet and then applying to another, carrying the relationship forward in time.
translation-light.code:
if separates_from(A) and then_applies_to(B):
    translation = True

collection-light.title: Collection of Light
collection-light.summary: Detect two planets applying to a slower third body.
collection-light.code:
if applies(A, C) and applies(B, C) and slower(C):
    collection = True

superior-inferior-speed.title: Superior / Inferior Planet Speed Logic
superior-inferior-speed.summary: Compare traditional planetary class, ordering, and relative apparent motion rather than treating all planets as dynamically interchangeable.

planetary-stations.title: Planetary Stations
planetary-stations.summary: Examine successive longitudes, unwrap the circle correctly, and detect apparent speed approaching zero or changing sign.

heliacal-phenomena.title: Heliacal Phenomena
heliacal-phenomena.summary: Combine solar separation, latitude, local horizon, altitude, and visibility thresholds to model emergence and disappearance.
heliacal-phenomena.code:
visible = heliacal_visibility(
    solar_separation, ecliptic_latitude,
    altitude, horizon, threshold
)

rising-times.title: Rising Times
rising-times.summary: Map zodiacal arcs to unequal ascensional times. Equal 30° signs do not necessarily rise in equal time.

ascensional-difference.title: Ascensional Difference
ascensional-difference.summary: Compare equinoctial measure with the locally rising measure to expose latitude-dependent inequality.

temporal-hours.title: Temporal Hours
temporal-hours.summary: Divide daylight and nighttime separately into twelve unequal hours.
temporal-hours.code:
day_hour = daylight_minutes / 12
night_hour = night_minutes / 12
print(day_hour, night_hour)

planetary-hours.title: Planetary Hours
planetary-hours.summary: Lay the Chaldean planetary sequence over temporal hours, beginning with the weekday ruler.

primary-direction-arcs.title: Primary-Direction Style Arc Measurements
primary-direction-arcs.summary: Measure a directed celestial arc and convert it to symbolic time according to the chosen directional procedure.

circumambulations.title: Circumambulations / Distributions Through Bounds
circumambulations.summary: Walk a directed point through successive unequal bounds, changing the time lord whenever a boundary is crossed.
circumambulations.code:
while arc_remaining > 0:
    bound = find_bound(position)
    distance = distance_to_bound_end(position)
    assign_time_lord(bound.ruler)
    advance(distance)

zodiacal-releasing.title: Zodiacal Releasing
zodiacal-releasing.summary: Generate nested sign periods from a starting Lot using planetary period lengths.

releasing-peak-periods.title: Peak Periods in Releasing
releasing-peak-periods.summary: Detect angular relationships between the current releasing sign and the sign of the starting Lot.

loosing-of-the-bond.title: Loosing of the Bond
loosing-of-the-bond.summary: Interrupt the ordinary sign-by-sign releasing sequence when the prescribed condition is reached and perform the special jump.
